title: SA-23E Starfury (Babylon 5)
intro: The Starfury is a fictional Earth Alliance fighter in the series Babylon 5. It has four thruster pods on X-shaped wings, flies by real space physics (it keeps drifting until pushed the other way) and can spin around to fire behind it. The pilot rides almost upright in a harness at the front, with a hand controller at each side.

areas.name: Canopy
areas.text: The forward window of the pod.

panels.name: Canopy
panels.text: The small window at the front of the cockpit pod.
panels.context: The pilot enters the pod from the back.

controls.name: Forward window
controls.text: A small window at the front of the pod; the pilot enters through a door at the rear.
controls.context: The upright position gives the pilot a view straight ahead through it.

areas.name: Forward displays
areas.text: Displays in front of the pilot.

panels.name: Forward displays
panels.text: Screens and lights in front of the pilot.
panels.context: They show targets, flight data and the state of the systems.

controls.name: Forward displays
controls.text: Screens in front of the pilot show the targeting and flight data.
controls.context: In space without up or down, the screens help the pilot keep track of where enemies are.

controls.name: Status lights
controls.text: Lights that show the state of the Starfury's systems.
controls.context: The series does not explain each light.

areas.name: Harness / seat
areas.text: The pilot rides almost upright, strapped in a harness.

panels.name: Harness / seat
panels.text: Instead of a normal seat, the pilot stands nearly upright in a harness.
panels.context: This position helps the pilot cope with the hard pushes of quick turns.

controls.name: Standing harness
controls.text: Straps hold the pilot upright against the strong pushes of hard manoeuvres.
controls.context: It is one of the Starfury's best-known features.

controls.name: Hand grips
controls.text: Grips at both hands work the four engine pods on the wing tips.
controls.context: Firing the pods in different directions lets the Starfury spin, slide and flip in space.

areas.name: Hand controllers
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Right-hand controller
panels.text: The hand grip at the pilot's right side.
panels.context: It steers the Starfury and fires the guns.

controls.name: Right-hand controller
controls.text: Moving this grip tips the nose up and down and rolls the fighter.
controls.context: Because the Starfury flies like a real spaceship, turning the nose does not change the drift direction by itself.

controls.name: Fire control
controls.text: A control on the grip fires the pulse cannons.
controls.context: The Starfury can turn around and fire backwards while still drifting forwards.

panels.name: Left-hand controller
panels.text: The hand grip at the Starfury pilot's left side.
panels.context: The catalog takes it as the thrust control.

controls.name: Left-hand controller (thrust)
controls.text: This grip is taken as the thrust control: it makes the engines push harder or softer.
controls.context: The series does not show exactly what the left grip does, so this is a guess of the catalog.
